Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You test the line, look back at your companions and show them where to put their hands.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Time
Ten minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One natural climb or gap and a suitable rope; ten minutes per attempt.
Duration
Until the rope is removed or the route changes.
Equipment / acquisition
Suitable rope required; grants an ordinary rope coil, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
One Boon per traveler per route; rebuilding the same route does not refresh it. Existing ordinary rope use remains possible.
Type
Skill / Utility

Establish a roped route toward a DA-declared progress target. You must reach and secure its anchors; this grants no remote placement or impossible foothold. On completion, you and up to six companions gain 1 Boon each to their next roll traversing this route while the rope remains secured.

Weak
1 progress; retain your safe grip.
Standard
2 progress; retain your grip and secure one carried item.
Strong
3 progress; gain both benefits and identify an available resting point along the route, if one exists.
